decisions.reason: Ambiguity: 3.2 defines uses as 'every place in the source that calls a footnote: each <ref> tag (with content, or self-closing …)'. The enumerated wording 'each <ref> tag' has no exception for a <ref> placed inside <references>…</references>, and 3.2 provides render_ref_id null 'when the use produces no marker you can identify'. The alternative (a list-defined ref is a definition only) imports MediaWiki semantics into 'calls a footnote' rather than following the guide's explicit enumeration. Following the wording most closely, the <ref name='tdk_sale_pr'> tag at cp 23310 is a use bound to itself (it is the ref with content), with render_ref_id null: render.html has only the two cite_ref-tdk_sale_pr markers belonging to earlier out-of-window reuses and no marker for this tag.
